title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: minimum automatic transfer amount by tier
content:
## Scope

This card gives, for each tier of Savings & Money Market Accounts, the smallest recurring automatic transfer amount that can be set up into the account.

## Definition

- **Minimum automatic transfer amount**: the smallest recurring automatic transfer amount that can be set up, in USD.

## Tier table

| Tier | Minimum automatic transfer amount |
|---|---|
| Starter Savings | USD 25.00 |
| Statement Savings | USD 25.00 |
| Goal Builder Savings | USD 25.00 |
| Money Market Account | USD 100.00 |
| Premier Money Market | USD 100.00 |
| Private Client Money Market | USD 100.00 |

## Points of judgement

**Can a recurring automatic transfer of USD 50.00 be set up into a Premier Money Market account?** No; USD 50.00 is below that tier's USD 100.00 minimum. The same USD 50.00 is not below the USD 25.00 minimum of Starter Savings, Statement Savings or Goal Builder Savings.

**Is a recurring transfer of exactly USD 100.00 into a Money Market Account below the minimum?** No; USD 100.00 is the smallest amount that can be set up on that tier.
